design.title: Sharper borrowed eyes: each member's MobileNetV2 trunk is replaced by an ImageNet-pretrained EfficientNet-B0 trunk (stem + all seven MBConv stages, Apache-2.0), read at the same two strides (112x14x14 and 320x7x7 at 224 px)
design.init_strategy: pretrained:efficientnet_b0 IMAGENET1K_V1 features[0..7] (torchvision, Apache-2.0 weights / BSD-3 code), fine-tuned at 0.1x LR
design.eli5: The model recognises Berlin through a pair of borrowed eyes: image-recognition networks first trained on a million everyday photos, then taught the city. Every time we gave it better eyes, it got better at recognising Berlin in a photograph it had never seen. This experiment swaps in EfficientNet-B0, the sharpest pair that still fits the drone's memory budget. It was trained to recognise things regardless of lighting and colour, and that is exactly what differs between two surveys of the same street.
design.hypothesis: On this ruler only the quality of the pretrained trunk has moved the held-out truedop_2024 photograph by a large step. From-scratch to MobileNetV3-Small took it from 10.75% to 49.5% usable (exp 12). Reading deeper gave 60.25% (exp 13), MixStyle 65.5% (exp 14), native 224 px input 74.25% (exp 15), and MobileNetV2 86.75% (exp 16, mission 0.155: false fix 2.25%, abstain 11%). Everything since then has been around the trunk and has not moved: exp 18's ring pooling scored 0.158, which is within noise of the champion. The three training photographs are saturated: in exp 16 and 18 bb_dop20, truedop_2022 and truedop_2023 are all 100% usable and 0% false fix at the same held-out viewpoints. So the remaining 0.155 is entirely survey gap, and most of it is abstention: 11% of 2024 frames fall under 0.3 committee confidence, while the confident answers are already 97.5% right (0.8675 of 0.89 coverage). What turns a 2024 abstention into a fix is the place feature landing closer to its prototype despite season, shadow and colour changes. That is the invariance the ImageNet trunk supplies, and it has grown with trunk strength at every step (MNv3-S 67.7% ImageNet top-1, MNv2 71.9%). EfficientNet-B0 is the strongest permissively licensed torchvision trunk that fits the gate: 77.7% top-1, squeeze-excite channel attention, and compound-scaled depth/width trained with heavy RandAugment-style photometric augmentation, i.e. invariances learned under exactly the nuisances that separate surveys. Its stride-16 and stride-32 outputs (112x14x14, 320x7x7 at 224 px) match the two levels the current place feature reads, so no other stage has to change. Size: features[0..7] is about 3.60M parameters, plus about 0.36M per member for lifts, prototypes and offset head, about 7.9M in total. That is about 31.6 MB, roughly 30.1 MiB fp32, against the 32 MiB gate, and BN folding at export lowers it slightly. The same arithmetic predicts exp 16's measured 17.39 MB for MobileNetV2 exactly. This is the trunk-family axis that every gain came from, not a variation of the refuted mechanisms (consistency losses, distillation, blending, decode changes).
